gloss.en: A shortened form; the act or result of shortening. Featured 瘪 is a cognitive candidate, not the translation.
gloss.zh-Hans: 缩写形式；缩略行为或结果。特色“瘪”为认知候选，不是标准翻译。

meaning.en: Noun abbreviation: a shorter written form, or the act/result of shortening. A reduced linguistic form ↔ reduced physical fullness (瘪) is a cognitive candidate. The verb abbreviate has its own entry.
meaning.zh-Hans: 名词 abbreviation：缩写形式，或缩略行为／结果。较短语言形式 ↔ 不饱满形态（瘪）为认知候选；动词 abbreviate 另有独立词条。

rationale.en: Standard Translation ≠ Featured Mapping ≠ Historical-unit Mapping. 瘪 is not the standard translation of the noun abbreviation. Only brev-/brevi- is compared phonetically; no whole-word homophony or historical relation is claimed.
rationale.zh-Hans: Standard Translation ≠ Featured Mapping ≠ Historical-unit Mapping。瘪不是名词 abbreviation 的标准翻译；声音只比较 brev-/brevi-，不主张整词同音或历史关系。

summary.en: English abbreviation continues Middle English abbreviacioun, borrowed via Anglo-French abreviation from Late Latin abbreviātiō, from abbreviāre plus the action-noun suffix -tiō. Modern French abréviation is also a Latin noun borrowing. This is the same brevis SHORT family as abbreviate, not another independent Chinese-mapping case.
summary.zh-Hans: 英语 abbreviation 经中古英语 abbreviacioun、盎格鲁法语 abreviation 借自晚期拉丁 abbreviātiō，属 abbreviāre 加动作名词后缀 -tiō 的词族。现代法语 abréviation 亦为拉丁名词借入；与 abbreviate 同属 brevis“短”词族，不另计独立汉语映射样本。

claim.en: English abbreviation continues Middle English abbreviacioun, borrowed via Anglo-French abreviation from Late Latin abbreviātiō, from abbreviāre plus the action-noun suffix -tiō. Modern French abréviation is also a Latin noun borrowing. This is the same brevis SHORT family as abbreviate, not another independent Chinese-mapping case.

summary.en: brev-/brevi- ↔ 瘪 biě has limited surface phonetic similarity. Latin reference [brɛw-]/[brɛwɪ-], modern English /briːv/ across the syllable boundary in /əˈbriː.vi.eɪt/, and Mandarin [piɛ˨˩˦] are different forms and layers.
summary.zh-Hans: brev-/brevi- ↔ 瘪 biě 只有有限表面音近。拉丁参考 [brɛw-]／[brɛwɪ-]、现代英语 /əˈbriː.vi.eɪt/ 内跨音节边界的 /briːv/ 与普通话 [piɛ˨˩˦] 是不同形式、不同层次。

claim.en: brev-/brevi- ↔ 瘪 biě has limited surface phonetic similarity. Latin reference [brɛw-]/[brɛwɪ-], modern English /briːv/ across the syllable boundary in /əˈbriː.vi.eɪt/, and Mandarin [piɛ˨˩˦] are different forms and layers.

phonetic_observation.scope: Historical-unit Latin brev-/brevi- compared with modern Mandarin; modern English reflex listed separately
phonetic_observation.reference_system: Approximate Roman reference from Allen & Greenough §8; broad IPA editorial inference. No uniform Late Latin realization or ancient Chinese reconstruction asserted.

consonants.en: Latin /b/ and English /b/ are voiced bilabial stops; Mandarin pinyin b is voiceless unaspirated [p]. Latin r and consonantal v [w], and English /r,v/, have no counterparts in biě. A b-p-m-f group hit is only a cross-language hypothesis.
consonants.zh-Hans: 拉丁和英语 /b/ 为浊双唇塞音，拼音 b 为清不送气 [p]。拉丁 r、辅音 v [w] 及英语 /r,v/ 在 biě 中无对应；b-p-m-f 同组命中仅属跨语言假说。

vowel.en: Latin short e, represented here as [ɛ], partly resembles Mandarin [iɛ]; English stressed /iː/ is not [iɛ]. Latin brevi- also contains short i.
vowel.zh-Hans: 拉丁短 e（此处宽式记 [ɛ]）与普通话 [iɛ] 局部接近；英语重读 /iː/ 并非 [iɛ]；拉丁 brevi- 另含短 i。

syllables.en: brev- is an extracted stem fragment, not a complete word or independently stressed syllable; brevi- includes a following vowel. brevis has two syllables and abbreviate four; biě has one. The English spelling brev spans /briː.v/, not a single /brɛv/ syllable.
syllables.zh-Hans: brev- 为抽取词干片段，不是完整词或独立重读音节；brevi- 多一个元音。brevis 为两音节，abbreviate 为四音节，abbreviation 为五音节，biě 为一音节。英语拼写 brev 跨 /briː.v/ 边界，不能按字母读成一个 /brɛv/ 音节。

stress.en: English abbreviate stresses /briː/; abbreviation shifts primary stress to /eɪ/. Extracted Latin stems have no independent word stress; stress of the host word must not be assigned to a root fragment.
stress.zh-Hans: abbreviate 主重音在 /briː/；abbreviation 主重音移至 /eɪ/。抽取的拉丁词干没有独立词重音，不能把整词重音强加给片段。

tone.en: Mandarin biě has third tone (citation [214]); bié has second tone [35]. English stress and Latin vowel quantity do not match Mandarin lexical tone. Citation contours do not describe all connected-speech realizations.
tone.zh-Hans: biě 为上声，单字调 [214]；bié 为阳平 [35]。英语重音、拉丁元音长短都不对应普通话词汇声调；单字调不代表所有连读实现。

rating.method: Unvalidated editorial rubric: bilabial stop place/manner 4/10; partial vowel resemblance 3/8; remaining consonants 0/5; extracted unit shape 1/4; prosody 0/3. Not an acoustic measurement, cognacy probability or whole-word score.

relation_to_entry.en: Separate verb entry: to shorten. Shared Latin family, not a second independent mapping sample.
relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: 独立动词词条：缩写／使简略／缩短。同一拉丁词族，不另算独立映射样本。

relation_to_entry.en: Latin noun borrowing within the Latin SHORT family; not an independent Chinese-mapping sample.
relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: 法语阴性名词：缩写、缩略形式；借自拉丁 abbreviatio，不是从现代 abréger 表面机械拆出的形式。

relation_to_entry.en: Standard Translation ≠ Featured Mapping ≠ Historical-unit Mapping. 瘪 is not the standard Chinese verb for abbreviate. The sound comparison concerns brev-/brevi-, not the whole English word. Historical Relation: Not claimed.
relation_to_entry.zh-Hans: Standard Translation ≠ Featured Mapping ≠ Historical-unit Mapping。瘪不是“缩写”的标准汉语动词；声音比较针对 brev-/brevi-，不是整个英语词。Historical Relation: Not claimed。

semantic_associations.relation: SHORT → REDUCE → COMPRESS maps abstract language shortening to a concrete loss of fullness. FULL/LONG → REDUCE → COMPRESSED/SHORT is an interpretive schema, not a dictionary definition or an established historical development.

hypotheses.type: Original Author Hypothesis / legacy phonetic-semantic observation

claim.en: The original shared legacy note motivates comparing brev-/brevi- with 瘪. In this noun entry the analogy concerns a shortened form or shortening result, not direct translation.
claim.zh-Hans: 共享旧笔记引出 brev-/brevi- 与瘪的比较。本名词词条的类比针对缩短形式或缩略结果，不是直接翻译。

counterexamples: No whole-word homophony; /r,w/ or /r,v/ and tone are unmatched.
瘪 is not the standard translation of abbreviation.
One Latin etymological family is one comparison, not multiple independent cases.

testability.en: Blind semantic ratings first; then auditory ratings with matched random syllables and 蹩 as a meaning-first negative control. Deduplicate the entire Latin SHORT family. No experiment has been run.
testability.zh-Hans: 先盲评语义，再用匹配随机音节评声音；蹩作 meaning-first 负对照；整个拉丁 SHORT 词族去重计一次。尚未进行实验。

statement.en: The real morpheme is the Latin SHORT family brev-/brevis; 瘪 is not its origin.
statement.zh-Hans: 真实语素属于拉丁语 SHORT 词族 brev-／brevis；“瘪”不是其来源。

proposition.en: SHORTEN → COMPRESS → ‘DEFLATE’ gives 瘪 a vivid mnemonic role.
proposition.zh-Hans: 缩短 → 压缩 → “变瘪”，使“瘪”可作生动记忆联想。

evidence_boundary.en: The legacy image may be developed as literature or mnemonic, but it is not historical evidence.
evidence_boundary.zh-Hans: 旧站意象可作为文学或记忆法展开，但不是历史证据。
